lines.zh: 壳上的星纹随步子晃动。
lines.en: The stars on my shell sway with each step.

lines.zh: 我从水边慢慢爬上陆地。
lines.en: I haul myself slowly from the water onto land.

lines.zh: 四爪陷进暮色的湿泥里。
lines.en: My four claws sink into the twilight mud.

lines.zh: 别催，我一步要走很久。
lines.en: Do not rush me; one step takes me a long while.

lines.zh: 壳太重，路太软，我认了。
lines.en: The shell is heavy, the path soft; I accept it.

lines.zh: 树影底下凉，我往那边挪。
lines.en: The shade is cool; I shuffle toward it.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子穿过暮色森林。
lines.en: I drag my shadow through the twilight woods.

lines.zh: 慢不是懒，是壳的规矩。
lines.en: Slow is not lazy; it is the shell's rule.

lines.zh: 前面那块石头我要爬上去。
lines.en: I intend to climb that stone ahead.

lines.zh: 我上岸只为晒一会儿壳。
lines.en: I come ashore only to dry my shell.

lines.zh: 脚步很沉，但从不迷路。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, but I never lose the way.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的脚印走。
lines.en: I walk around your footprints.

lines.zh: 这坡对我算是高山了。
lines.en: This slope counts as a mountain to me.

lines.zh: 走一步，壳里的星就亮一下。
lines.en: Each step makes the stars in my shell flicker.

lines.zh: 星光落在壳上，我又走一步。
lines.en: Starlight lands on my shell. One more step.

lines.zh: 我绕过一株发光的蘑菇。
lines.en: I go around a glowing mushroom.

lines.zh: 泥太软，我的爪印很深。
lines.en: The mud is soft. My prints run deep.

lines.zh: 前爪先落，后爪再跟上。
lines.en: Front claws first, hind claws after.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸到最长，晒背。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out full length to sun my back.

lines.zh: 壳上的星纹今天更清楚了。
lines.en: The star patterns on my shell are clearer today.

lines.zh: 水声在壳下嗡嗡地响。
lines.en: Water hums beneath the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶漏下的光斑。
lines.en: I count the light spots leaking through the leaves.

lines.zh: 缩进壳里，世界就安静了。
lines.en: Pulled into my shell, the world goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等苔藓长满背甲。
lines.en: I am waiting for moss to cover my backplate.

lines.zh: 暮色的风总是带一点凉。
lines.en: The twilight wind always carries a little chill.

lines.zh: 眨眼放到最慢，我快睡着了。
lines.en: My blink slows until I nearly sleep.

lines.zh: 壳沿磕在石头上，闷响一声。
lines.en: My shell rim knocks a stone with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我把前爪收进腹甲底下。
lines.en: I tuck my foreclaws under my belly plate.

lines.zh: 水草的味道还留在嘴边。
lines.en: The taste of waterweed lingers at my mouth.

lines.zh: 星壳龟不需要赶路。
lines.en: A Starshell Turtle has no road to hurry down.

lines.zh: 我听见树林在慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I hear the woods breathing very slowly.

lines.zh: 等太阳挪过来，我再动。
lines.en: I will move once the sun shifts over here.

lines.zh: 我数壳上的星，数到第九。
lines.en: I count the stars on my shell to nine.

lines.zh: 露水顺着壳沿滴下去。
lines.en: Dew runs off my shell's rim.

lines.zh: 你站在我和太阳中间。
lines.en: You stand between me and the sun.

lines.zh: 我从壳沿下面看你。
lines.en: I look at you from under my shell rim.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我星纹上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my star markings.

lines.zh: 蹲下来，我看不清你。
lines.en: Crouch down; I cannot see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我抬头的速度就到这里。
lines.en: This is as fast as I can raise my head.

lines.zh: 你身上没有暮色的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of the twilight.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，壳会硌你。
lines.en: Not so close; my shell will bruise you.

lines.zh: 我在记你的鞋尖。
lines.en: I am memorizing the tips of your boots.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就慢慢看你。
lines.en: You watch me; I will slowly watch you.

lines.zh: 眼睛转得慢，但看得清。
lines.en: My eyes turn slowly, yet they see clearly.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我壳上有字吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is there writing on my shell?

lines.zh: 我认得你，你是刚才那块影子。
lines.en: I know you; you were that shadow earlier.

lines.zh: 哎哟，你敲到我的壳了。
lines.en: Ouch, you struck my shell!

lines.zh: 你敲在壳缝上了。
lines.en: You struck the seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，壳纹一道没断。
lines.en: It stings, yet not one star line broke.

lines.zh: 我缩进去了，别再来。
lines.en: I am pulling in; do not come again.

lines.zh: 星纹都震花了。
lines.en: The star patterns rattled blurry.

lines.zh: 这一下比石头砸的还重。
lines.en: That hurt more than a falling stone.

lines.zh: 我血流得慢，痛得久。
lines.en: My blood runs slow, so the pain lasts.

lines.zh: 别打壳沿，那里薄。
lines.en: Not the rim; it is thin there.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在壳纹里。
lines.en: This blow stays carved in my shell.

lines.zh: 你下手比我爬得快多了。
lines.en: You strike far faster than I crawl.

lines.zh: 水草？我确实有点饿。
lines.en: Waterweed? I am indeed a little hungry.

lines.zh: 你把菜叶举高也没用。
lines.en: Holding the leaf up high will not help you.

lines.zh: 我爬过去要很久，你得等着。
lines.en: I will take long to crawl there; you must wait.

lines.zh: 我闻到水汽，就往这边挪。
lines.en: I smell water and shuffle this way.

lines.zh: 食物放地上，别晃来晃去。
lines.en: Put the food down and stop waving it about.

lines.zh: 我嘴慢，抢不过别的生物。
lines.en: My mouth is slow; I lose races for food.

lines.zh: 这一口能让我撑一整天。
lines.en: One bite of this will last me all day.

lines.zh: 手腕再垂些，我脖子不够长。
lines.en: Lower your wrist; my neck is short.

lines.zh: 我从不挑食，只挑近的。
lines.en: I never pick favorites, only whatever is nearest.

lines.zh: 诱惑我？我壳里全是耐心。
lines.en: Tempting me? My shell is full of patience.

lines.zh: 这味道像浅滩上的嫩芽。
lines.en: This smells like tender shoots from the shallows.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，反正你会等着。
lines.en: I come slowly; you will wait anyway.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，脖子都伸长了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet and stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 一口就好，我不贪心。
lines.en: Just one mouthful; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 海带的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of kelp.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才肯靠近。
lines.en: Crouch down, and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 哎，你踩到我壳沿了。
lines.en: Hey, you stepped on my shell rim.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，疼的是你的脚。
lines.en: Bump me and your foot is what hurts.

lines.zh: 我挪不快，你绕一下吧。
lines.en: I cannot move aside quickly; go around.

lines.zh: 壳很硬，我也没办法。
lines.en: The shell is hard; I cannot help that.

lines.zh: 别推，我会连人带壳翻过去。
lines.en: Do not push, or I will roll over shell and all.

lines.zh: 你踢我，星纹也不会掉。
lines.en: Kick me; the star patterns will not come off.

lines.zh: 我们卡在一起了，谁先退？
lines.en: We are stuck together; who backs off first?

lines.zh: 我退半步要花很久。
lines.en: Backing up half a step takes me ages.

lines.zh: 你这么急，是要去哪儿？
lines.en: You are in such a hurry; where are you going?

lines.zh: 石头和壳碰在一起就这声音。
lines.en: That is the sound of stone meeting shell.

lines.zh: 另一只星壳龟在树影下等我。
lines.en: Another Starshell Turtle waits for me in the shade.

lines.zh: 我们并排爬，壳碰壳。
lines.en: We crawl side by side, shell against shell.

lines.zh: 星纹多的那只更受欢迎。
lines.en: The one with more star markings is better liked.

lines.zh: 我们一对，从不多带第三只。
lines.en: We pair off and never bring a third along.

lines.zh: 慢慢靠近，这才叫求婚。
lines.en: Approaching slowly; that is how one proposes.

lines.zh: 我把头缩回去，算是害羞。
lines.en: I pull my head in; that counts as shyness.

lines.zh: 两只壳叠在一起，像块石头。
lines.en: Two shells stacked look like one boulder.

lines.zh: 我们约在暮色的浅水边见。
lines.en: We meet at the shallows of the twilight.

lines.zh: 她的壳比我的圆一点。
lines.en: Her shell is a little rounder than mine.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在办正事。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are busy with important things.

lines.zh: 放我下来，我四条腿在空蹬。
lines.en: Put me down; my four legs are paddling air.

lines.zh: 你抱起我，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: You lift me and my whole body goes stiff.

lines.zh: 壳底朝上，这可太难受了。
lines.en: Shell-side up is deeply uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我这么重，你抱不了多久。
lines.en: I am this heavy; you cannot hold me long.

lines.zh: 别把我翻过来，星纹会磨掉。
lines.en: Do not flip me; the stars will wear off.

lines.zh: 我在你手里缩成了石头。
lines.en: In your hands I shrink into a stone.

lines.zh: 你身上有股奇怪的铁味。
lines.en: You smell strangely of iron.

lines.zh: 轻点，壳里还有我的晚饭。
lines.en: Easy; my dinner is still inside this shell.

lines.zh: 我宁愿自己爬，真的。
lines.en: I would honestly rather crawl myself.

lines.zh: 放下我，我就当没发生过。
lines.en: Set me down and I will pretend this never happened.

lines.zh: 我很少盯上谁，你是例外。
lines.en: I rarely fix on anyone; you are the exception.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的壳三次。
lines.en: You stepped on my shell three times.

lines.zh: 我决定了，今天要撞你一下。
lines.en: I have decided to bump you once today.

lines.zh: 别跑，我追得很慢。
lines.en: Do not run; I chase very slowly.

lines.zh: 我脖子伸出壳外，就是警告。
lines.en: My neck out of the shell is a warning.

lines.zh: 你抢走了我晒背的位置。
lines.en: You took the spot where I sun my shell.

lines.zh: 我要用壳顶你，忍着点。
lines.en: I will butt you with my shell; endure it.

lines.zh: 星壳龟生气时也不快。
lines.en: Even angry, a Starshell Turtle is not fast.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的脚印方向。
lines.en: I have memorized which way your footprints lead.

lines.zh: 这次我不缩壳了。
lines.en: This time I will not retreat into my shell.

lines.zh: 我在慢慢对准你。
lines.en: I am slowly lining myself up with you.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，我就到。
lines.en: Wait a little longer; I am almost there.

lines.zh: 壳沿已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My shell rim is already raised.

lines.zh: 你退后也没用，我认方向。
lines.en: Retreating will not help; I know your direction.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，算得很慢。
lines.en: I am calculating distance, and calculating slowly.

lines.zh: 三块石头，再两步。
lines.en: Three stones, then two more steps.

lines.zh: 别停在我壳尖对着的地方。
lines.en: Do not linger where my shell points.

lines.zh: 脖子缩低，我准备往前顶。
lines.en: Neck pulled low, I ready a forward shove.

lines.zh: 你还在原地，很好。
lines.en: You are still there; good.

lines.zh: 星纹朝前，那就是我冲的方向。
lines.en: The stars face forward; that is where I charge.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，抱歉。
lines.en: I butted you once; my apologies.

lines.zh: 壳撞上去，声音很闷。
lines.en: The shell lands with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 就这一下，我没力气再撞。
lines.en: That is the one hit; I have no strength for more.

lines.zh: 两步，正好够我收壳。
lines.en: Two steps back; enough for me to withdraw.

lines.zh: 我的攻击像关门一样慢。
lines.en: My attacks close in as slowly as a door.

lines.zh: 壳比牙好用，我早知道了。
lines.en: A shell beats teeth; I learned that long ago.

lines.zh: 壳撞完，我脑袋还在晃。
lines.en: After the butt, my head is still ringing.

lines.zh: 先动手的是你的靴子。
lines.en: Your boot started this, not me.

lines.zh: 这一下用掉我半天的劲。
lines.en: That blow used half a day of my strength.

lines.zh: 我只会这一招，但很实在。
lines.en: I know only this move, but it lands.

lines.zh: 我从暮色的浅水里爬出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the twilight shallows.

lines.zh: 壳沿上挂着几缕水草。
lines.en: A few strands of waterweed hang on my rim.

lines.zh: 这一带树影够深，我住下。
lines.en: The shade here is deep enough; I will stay.

lines.zh: 谷里新来了一只星壳龟。
lines.en: A new Starshell Turtle has arrived in the vale.

lines.zh: 我和同伴一共两只。
lines.en: My companion and I make two in all.

lines.zh: 泥里有我想要的味道。
lines.en: The mud holds a taste I want.

lines.zh: 我刚睁开眼，就看见树。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and saw trees.

lines.zh: 星纹在暗处也亮着。
lines.en: The star markings glow even in the dark.

lines.zh: 这块岸够平，适合晒壳。
lines.en: This bank is flat enough for sunning.

lines.zh: 我从很远的水边走到这里。
lines.en: I walked here from a far-off shore.

lines.zh: 壳烫得像烙铁。
lines.en: My shell is hot as a branding iron.

lines.zh: 从石头上摔下来，壳先落地。
lines.en: I fell from the stone, shell first.

lines.zh: 我能憋气，但别按我。
lines.en: I can hold my breath, but do not hold me under.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我和石头一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flipped me and the stones together.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我星纹中间。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck between my star markings.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进壳缝，凉得刺骨。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my shell seam, cold and sharp.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃到水草了。
lines.en: I have not tasted waterweed in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，壳里全是回声。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my shell rings with echoes.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，壳也护不住。
lines.en: I am falling, and my shell cannot shield me.
